description: Drill-down report for a single KPI measurement (script). Opened from the KPI Measurement dashboard Report links.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT er.success) AS "Failed",
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Success Rate",
  MIN(er.kpi_measurement_ms) AS "Best (ms)",
  ROUND(AVG(er.kpi_measurement_ms))::int AS "Mean (ms)",
  MAX(er.kpi_measurement_ms) AS "Worst (ms)"
FROM execution_results er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (ui.name IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (er.action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = er.host_name AND df.device_name = er.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))

panels.title: Availability Trend
panels.description: Script success rate per 30m; Failed = run count (toggle in legend)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(er.executed_at, '30m'),
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN er.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Passed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT er.success) AS "Failed"
FROM execution_results er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (ui.name IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (er.action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = er.host_name AND df.device_name = er.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT er.executed_at AS "time", COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') AS metric, er.kpi_measurement_ms AS "KPI (ms)"
FROM execution_results er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (ui.name IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (er.action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = er.host_name AND df.device_name = er.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Success Over Time
panels.description: Last run state per 5m per variant/model lane (green = passed, red = failed)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(er.executed_at, '5m'),
  COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') || ' - ' || COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') AS metric,
  (array_agg(er.success::int ORDER BY er.executed_at DESC))[1] AS "state"
FROM execution_results er
LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id
LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id
WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at)
  AND (ui.name IN (${user_interface:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring}))
  AND (er.action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring}))
  AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = er.host_name AND df.device_name = er.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT er.executed_at as "Executed At", er.host_name as "Roboter", er.device_name as "Device", ui.name as "User Interface", COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') as "Variant", er.is_test as "Is Test", er.action_set_id as "Action Set ID", CASE WHEN CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(thr.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(thr.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END || CASE WHEN NULLIF(thr.edge_label, '') IS NOT NULL AND thr.edge_label <> CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(thr.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END THEN ' — ' || thr.edge_label ELSE '' END ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(thr.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(thr.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id) END as "KPI Name", er.device_model as "Device Model", nt.name as "Tree Name", er.kpi_measurement_ms as "KPI Time (ms)", er.kpi_measurement_success as "Success", er.kpi_measurement_error as "Error", CASE WHEN sr.html_report_r2_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'link' END AS "Script Report", CASE WHEN er.kpi_report_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'link' END AS "KPI Report" FROM execution_results er LEFT JOIN script_results sr ON er.script_result_id = sr.id LEFT JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id LEFT JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT as_elem->>'kpi_name' AS kpi_name, as_elem->>'label' AS edge_label FROM navigation_edges ne, jsonb_array_elements(ne.action_sets) AS as_elem WHERE ne.edge_id = regexp_replace(er.edge_id, '_reverse$', '') AND ne.tree_id = er.tree_id AND as_elem->>'id' = er.action_set_id LIMIT 1 ) thr ON true WHERE (er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL) AND $__timeFilter(er.executed_at) AND (ui.name IN (${user_interface:sqlstring})) AND (COALESCE(er.variant, 'Base') IN (${variant:sqlstring})) AND (er.action_set_id IN (${action_set:sqlstring})) AND (COALESCE(er.device_model, 'unknown') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = er.host_name AND df.device_name = er.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ','))) ORDER BY er.executed_at DESC

list.label: User Interface
list.name: user_interface
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ui.name FROM execution_results er JOIN navigation_trees nt ON er.tree_id = nt.id JOIN userinterfaces ui ON nt.userinterface_id = ui.id WHERE er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.label: Variant
list.name: variant
list.query: SELECT 'Base' AS variant UNION SELECT name FROM userinterface_variants UNION SELECT DISTINCT variant FROM execution_results WHERE variant IS NOT NULL ORDER BY variant

list.label: Model
list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(device_model, 'unknown') AS model FROM execution_results WHERE kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.label: KPI
list.name: action_set
list.query:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END) = 0
    THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
  WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END) = 1
    AND MIN(CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END) = COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
    THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
  ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(lbl.edge_label, ''), NULLIF(lbl.kpi_name, ''), er.action_set_id)
    || ' — ' || STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sr.script_name = 'standby_measurement' AND COALESCE(lbl.edge_label, '') NOT ILIKE '%standby%' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(er.kpi_display_label, '') END, ', ')
  END AS __text, er.action_set_id AS __value
FROM execution_results er
LEFT JOIN script_results sr ON er.script_result_id = sr.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT as_elem->>'kpi_name' AS kpi_name, as_elem->>'label' AS edge_label
  FROM navigation_edges ne, jsonb_array_elements(ne.action_sets) AS as_elem
  WHERE ne.edge_id = regexp_replace(er.edge_id, '_reverse$', '')
    AND ne.tree_id = er.tree_id
    AND as_elem->>'id' = er.action_set_id
  LIMIT 1
) lbl ON true
WHERE er.kpi_measurement_ms IS NOT NULL OR er.kpi_measurement_success IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY er.action_set_id
ORDER BY __text
